details.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash was DeepSeek's mid-sized mixture-of-experts chat model, publicly released July 31, 2026 (as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731) superseding an April 2026 preview, with 284 billion total parameters and 13 billion active per token per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card. It offered a 1,000,000-token context window, three reasoning-effort levels (low, high, max), and native support for OpenAI's Responses API adapted for Codex integration. DeepSeek retired the model on September 10, 2026: requests sent to the model id deepseek-v4-flash are now automatically served by the newer, multimodal DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and billed at Flash pricing, which is why this id now also accepts image input even though the original DeepSeek-V4-Flash release was text-only.
advantages: Scores 91.6 on LiveCodeBench in Think Max mode, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 88.1 on GPQA Diamond in Think Max mode, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Offered three reasoning-effort levels (low, high, max) to trade off latency against reasoning depth.
Requests to this model id are now served by the newer DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which DeepSeek reports scores ahead of DeepSeek-V4-Flash on agentic and reasoning benchmarks.
disadvantages: The original DeepSeek-V4-Flash model was retired by DeepSeek on September 10, 2026; this id is now an alias routed to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash rather than a distinct, actively maintained model.
The original release was text-only with no image or audio input; any current multimodal behavior on this id comes solely from the underlying routing to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
use_cases: Agentic coding tasks, with native support for OpenAI's Responses API format adapted for Codex integration.
Tool-calling agent workflows described by DeepSeek as 'daily Agent workflows' at the high reasoning-effort level.
Long-context document or codebase analysis using up to a 1,000,000-token context window.
General chat and reasoning tasks with adjustable reasoning effort (low, high, max).

notes: The generic id deepseek-v4-flash has been retired by DeepSeek since Sept 10, 2026 and now routes to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, billed at Flash pricing; DeepSeek's docs describe this as a 'temporary' compatibility route with legacy names 'still accepted' but give no future removal date, which is consistent with the catalog's empty deprecation_date for this id (unlike its dated sibling deepseek-v4-flash-0731, which providers have scheduled for removal). Catalog's modality (image_input + text_input + text_output) does not match the original DeepSeek-V4-Flash release, which was text-only; it matches the multimodal DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model this id is now silently routed to, so the description explains rather than contradicts this fact. Evaluations are Instruct-model, Think Max mode scores from the Hugging Face card; a Codeforces rating (3052) and base-checkpoint-only scores (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, LongBench-V2) were excluded as not 0-100 instruct-model accuracy figures.
